abilities.name: Leader
abilities.text: Before the battle, in the Muster Armies step, for each leader and support unit in your army, you can select one friendly bodyguard unit that unit can lead. That unit will then lead that bodyguard unit for the battle and form an attached unit with it. Unless otherwise stated, each bodyguard unit can only have one leader unit and one support unit attached to it. See Attached Units (19)

abilities.name: Cold and Calculating
abilities.originalText: In your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when this unit is selected to attack, you can select one of the following for this unit’s attacks to have: [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle]. Or: [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle]. Or: If the tactical doctrine is active for this unit, [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle] and [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle].

abilities.name: Feel No Pain 5+
abilities.originalText: This ability always takes the form Feel No Pain X+. Each time a model with this ability would lose a wound, roll one D6: on an X+, that wound is not lost.

abilities.name: Cerebrex Logic Engine
abilities.text: In the Declare Battle Formations step, you can select one friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit. That unit has Scouts 6".
abilities.originalText: In the Declare Battle Formations step, you can select one friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit. That unit has Scouts 6".

abilities.name: Deep Strike
abilities.text: Each time this unit makes an ingress move (20.04), if every model in this unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units, even if that is within your opponent's deployment zone.

abilities.name: Master of the Forge
abilities.trigger: ¿Hay una unidad VEHÍCULO de Adeptus Astartes aliada dentro de 3" de este modelo?
abilities.originalText: In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit’s move, you can select one friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle model within 3" of this model:  That Vehicle model heals 3 wounds. That Vehicle model’s attacks can ignore modifiers to the following until the start of your next Movement phase: BS. Hit rolls and wound rolls.

abilities.name: Rites of Tempering
abilities.trigger: ¿El ataque tiene una Fuerza superior a la Resistencia de esta unidad?
abilities.originalText: Attacks that target this unit with a S greater than this unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
